description: Binary WIN/LOSS classifier for the WATCH category, trained on true 90-day-horizon outcomes (not the legacy 7-day proxy -- see CATEGORY_HORIZONS in outcome_tracker.py). 80/20 chronological train/holdout split, no shuffling. holdout_auc is this model's AUC on the held-out 20%, gated at 0.53 before deploy (see 'deployed' field).
